title: A Skin Patch That Reads Your Pulse Without Electronics
paragraphs: A new patch can show your pulse. It has no battery. It has no wires.
The patch is made of soft rubber. It sticks to your skin. When your pulse moves your skin, the patch changes colour a little.
A phone camera can see the colour change. Scientists in Norway made the patch. They want to help people check their hearts.
